summary: All 45 rows cite existing evidence files; 3 fresh-seed fuzz runs (2520 live cases, truck vs OCCT, plus closed form for circle-circle), the 1420-case r4 battery and the options probe found 0 guard-pass-but-wrong volumes. One real guard hole found: needle lofts (length/width >= ~1e4..1e6) pass the guard with exact volume but truck drops 2 faces, contradicting the rows' equal-face-count claim; the guard is also documented as NOT WIRED.

defects.feature: blend: rect to rect / same-count parallel polygons (rows 5, 6)
defects.problem: No upper bound on loft length vs section width for straight-sided pairs: at length/width >= 1e6 (rect 0.01->0.02 at h=1e4, hex/triangle h=1e5) the guard passes, volume is exact (<1e-11) but truck returns 2 fewer faces than OCCT (6/4, 8/6, 5/3). The rows and the gate define 'wrong' as equal face counts, so the claim 'equal face counts' fails on an untested extreme (the sliver rule covers thin, not needle).

Stored r4 results are stale against the current guard: 39 'fuzz7p corner nudged 1e-7..1e-6' cases were guard-refused in the stored file and are passed live. They are exact (0 wrong) but evidence files no longer reproduce the guard's decisions; rows say round 4 while the guard is round 5.
Only one oracle (OCCT) for truck volume; no closed form, brep-rs refuses or is index-paired. Bar 3e-4 (tessellation); observed up to 1.7e-4, so a measured 1e-4-class error is accepted, not exact.
Guard also passes slightly non-parallel hand-typed polygons (near/typed populations) with true error up to 2.5e-5; accepted at the 3e-4 bar, but the row text states 1e-9.

defects.feature: guard not wired / studio button path
defects.problem: Both are recorded as 'wrong' rows: the guard and its post-check are not imported by packages/, so the product still builds wrong solids silently. Disclosed honestly; supported rows hold only through the guarded rig.
